clue.text: One adult after posh cap finds ideal place

indicators.note: after puts one adult behind the posh cap in the answer

parts.note: U is the old label for upper-class, posh usage
a cap or lid is a top
one is I, the Roman numeral
A is the film-rating abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: Someone adds a posh hat to their outfit and finds themselves in paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas More's imaginary island gave its name to any perfect, ideal society or place.

clue.text: Arranged to repeat a theatrical production

indicators.note: arranged signals that the letters of the words to repeat are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A stage show is scheduled for a second run.
explanation.definitionFit: An operetta is a light opera, one kind of staged musical show.

clue.text: Amateur demanding expenses, no matter what

parts.note: a tall order is a demanding one, so tall means demanding
expenses are costs

explanation.surface: An amateur insists on having his expenses paid regardless.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means whatever the price or consequence, i.e. regardless of anything.

clue.text: Condemn piece of dull writing about cattle stall

indicators.note: about means going around, so the writing surrounds the stall

parts.note: prose can mean plain, dull, unimaginative writing
a crib is a manger or stall for cattle

explanation.surface: A critic denounces a boring essay about a cowshed.
explanation.definitionFit: To proscribe something is to forbid or denounce it, a synonym for condemning.

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits inside the words metal containers

explanation.surface: Some powder is stored in tins.
explanation.definitionFit: Talc is a soft mineral ground into a fine body powder.

clue.text: Sergeant Major, breaking phone, becomes gloomy

indicators.note: breaking means splitting into, so the major goes inside the phone word

parts.note: to dial is to phone someone

explanation.surface: A drill sergeant smashing a telephone is in a foul mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismal and gloomy are synonyms describing a dreary, depressing mood or scene.

indicators.note: redistributed tells us the letters of this year are shared out afresh

explanation.surface: A craze has spread around again over the last twelve months.
explanation.definitionFit: Hysteria is uncontrolled excitement, a synonym for a frenzy.

clue.text: One likely to have a nap in the afternoon?

definitions.text: One likely to have a nap in the afternoon?

parts.words: One likely to have a nap in the afternoon?
parts.note: suggests a sleepy person dozing after lunch, but a nap is a racing ... most confident selection, and race meetings run in the afternoon

explanation.surface: Someone who habitually dozes after lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: In horse racing a nap is the tipster's best bet of the day; 'nap' pretends to mean a short sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing adviser gives out naps, so one is very likely to have a nap for the afternoon's races.

parts.note: R is short for rex, king
a secret that is out has been revealed

explanation.surface: A monarch's crushing win is made public.
explanation.definitionFit: A rout is a total defeat of an enemy, so for the winner a decisive victory.

clue.text: I invested in property, in fact

indicators.note: invested in means placed inside, as money is put into a scheme

parts.note: realty is real estate, property

explanation.surface: Someone admits they really did put money into real estate.
explanation.definitionFit: Reality is what actually exists, a near-synonym for fact.

clue.text: Our pilots flying out of capital

indicators.note: flying suggests letters scattered through the air, so our pilots is rearranged

explanation.surface: Airline crew depart from a nation's chief city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of' just joins the anagram to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital city of Mauritius, an Indian Ocean island nation.

clue.text: Arrive on time bringing one of Santa's reindeer

parts.note: to arrive is to come

explanation.surface: Turning up punctually with a reindeer from Santa's team.
explanation.definitionFit: Comet is one of the reindeer named in the poem A Visit from St Nicholas.

definitions.meaning: ... style, from ancient Athens, means pure, simple and refined
a loft space just under the roof

explanation.definitionFit: Attica was Athens' region, so its style means classically elegant; an attic is also a top-floor room.

parts.note: looks like people-trafficking, but Arabs here are horses, and a thief of livestock is meant

explanation.surface: Someone smuggling people from the Middle East.
explanation.walkthrough: Arabs are a breed of horse, so the thief is a horse thief.
explanation.definitionFit: A thief who steals horses or cattle would take Arab horses illegally.

parts.note: sugar is a sweet substance, and sweet is a term of endearment
old man is slang for father, daddy

explanation.surface: An elderly gentleman at Tate & Lyle, the sugar firm.
explanation.walkthrough: Tate here is Tate & Lyle, the British sugar refiner, not the art gallery; a father working there would be a 'sugar daddy'.
explanation.definitionFit: A sugar daddy is a rich older man who lavishes gifts on a younger partner.

clue.text: Extremely thorough moreover checking seconds — there's nothing more to be done

definitions.text: there's nothing more to be done

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extremities, the first and last letters, of thorough
checking means holding back or containing, so moreover surrounds seconds

parts.note: and at that means moreover, giving at that

explanation.surface: A meticulous inspector double-checks before declaring the job finished.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is said to declare a matter closed, meaning nothing more can be done.

clue.text: Ploughing ahead with it begs this question?

indicators.note: ploughing churns soil over, so the letters of ahead with it begs are turned about

explanation.surface: Someone barging on regardless invites a puzzled challenge.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an indignant question demanding to know someone's intentions.

definitions.meaning: Wellington's 1815 defeat of Napoleon in Belgium

explanation.definitionFit: It is both ABBA's hit record and the site of Napoleon's final battle.

indicators.note: careers is a verb meaning rushes wildly, so the letters of act ended run out of control

explanation.surface: A self-indulgent performance finished people's careers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'careers' looks like a noun, jobs, but it is a verb, hurtles about, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Decadent describes self-indulgent luxury and moral decline.

indicators.note: includes means the feature word holds the compass points inside

parts.note: a trait is a distinguishing feature

explanation.surface: A TV programme on the novel North and South covers a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is passage from one place to another.

indicators.note: parting means splitting apart, so the member goes into the middle of the drink

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer
a leg is a limb, or member; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: Someone holds a farewell drink in a club member's honour.

start of picks the first letter of race

parts.note: a cap is awarded to a sportsperson for an international appearance, so an international is a cap

explanation.definitionFit: To recap is to run over the main points again.

definitions.meaning: a client, especially of a bookmaker
one who propels a flat-bottomed boat with a pole on a river

explanation.definitionFit: Punter is slang for a customer and literally one who poles a punt along.

parts.note: an aga is an Ottoman military commander

explanation.surface: An elderly German officer is losing his grip.

explanation.definitionFit: A definition by example: this is a common English given name for a male child.

definitions.meaning: the cards held by one player in a game

explanation.definitionFit: A hand is a labourer and the set of cards dealt to a player.

definitions.meaning: an outdoor cafe serving tea and refreshments
Jack ..., the American jazz trombonist who led his own band

clue.text: Zoe originally seen wearing angora woolly, a silky material

woolly means fuzzy or confused, so angora is jumbled
originally picks the first letter of Zoe

explanation.walkthrough: 'woolly' turns ANGORA into ORGANA, and 'wearing' puts Z inside it.

clue.text: Musical instruction given in article by famous Florentine

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
Dante Alighieri, the poet, was born in Florence

explanation.surface: A music direction appears in a piece by a celebrated Italian poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Andante is a tempo marking telling players to go at a moderate walking pace.
